name: Udai Kensuke
source:
A 24 years old salesman. He lived with his girlfriend Ayumu, but had to move to another branch of the company in a different city for 6 months. 
He still loves Ayumu and dates her on the weekends, but there is four girls in the new city that are tempting him.
